title: Prottoyon
headline: All certificates in one place
summary: A government app for easy digital certificate applications in Bangladesh.
cover_alt: Prottoyon cover: the app name in Bangla and English above three phones showing the splash screen, the home screen and the certificate services.
cover_caption: Prottoyon: all certificates in one place.

story.heading: Overview
story.body: Prottoyon is a government service app designed to help Bangladeshi citizens apply for various digital certificates (e.g., birth, death, nationality) in a hassle-free way. Our team conducted a complete UX redesign to improve the app’s usability, navigation, and accessibility, especially for users with limited digital literacy. By simplifying the user flow and making key services easier to access, we aimed to build a more inclusive digital experience for all citizens.
